title: Extract a duplicated helper into a shared module
task: wrap() is defined identically in both a.js and b.js. Extract it into a new file lib/wrap.js, export it from there, and have a.js and b.js require it instead of each defining their own copy. The program output must stay exactly the same: `node main.js` must still print `a:<x>` then `b:<y>`.

llmReview.criteria: A single shared lib/wrap.js now holds wrap(), both a.js and b.js import it instead of defining their own copy, and behaviour is unchanged.
